# Section Structure

### Early H3 before any H2

This H3 belongs to the top prose, so it has no number.

## First section

Text in the first section.

### First sub

Sub text.

```markdown
## Not a heading inside a fence
### Not a sub heading inside a fence
```

#### Deep heading

Still inside the first sub section.

### Second sub

Second sub text.

## Second section ##

The closing hashes above are dropped from the heading.

## ##

The line above has no heading text, so it is body text of the second section.

## Third section

Last section.
